requirements.R_CLI: Unknown verb/flag, missing required flags, or empty --event-id exit 2 without touching journal, sqlite, checkpoint, or out files.
requirements.R_WINDOW: Gate-in honors yard_tz windows including DST.
requirements.R_GRACE: grace_early_minutes and grace_late_minutes accept in-band arrivals and reject beyond the band.
requirements.R_CONFIG: yard.json grace minutes change window matching.
requirements.R_CLOCK: LIVE clock_start is max(window_start, gate_in); drop/pickup uses gate_in.
requirements.R_SPOT: A second occupant of a busy spot is SPOT_OCCUPIED.
requirements.R_MOVE: IN_TRANSIT vacates origin, reserves dest; confirm relocates; cancel restores origin; reserved dest blocks another dispatch.
requirements.R_DOOR: REEFER_53 needs a plug; DROP_IN may not occupy DOCK_APRON.
requirements.R_CHASSIS: Grounded drop equipment needs wheels before IN_TRANSIT; mount clears on_ground and is exclusive.
requirements.R_HOLD: Active holds block gate-out until release.
requirements.R_PAUSE: YARD holds pause detention; CARRIER holds do not.
requirements.R_EVENT: Identical event_id+payload replays; different payload is EVENT_CONFLICT.
requirements.R_SEAL: Loaded live types require a seal.
requirements.R_CONTRACT: Missing SCAC/visit_type in carrier_contracts.json is CONTRACT_MISSING.
requirements.R_IDENTITY: Open visits are unique per (scac, trailer).
requirements.R_POOL: Pool appointments match the appointment SCAC only.
requirements.R_WAREHOUSE: Snapshot and detention omit prior-cycle warehouse visits.
requirements.R_HEALTH: health.ok requires matching seqs, occupancy digest, and warehouse_untouched.
requirements.R_JOURNAL: Sqlite catch-up from the checkpoint fence does not double-occupy.
requirements.R_PRESERVE: yardctl, contract, scale, and shipped timezone/grace remain present.

CLI_USAGE.rationale: Three probes of the same usage fence: unknown verb, empty event-id, and missing required flags.

GRACE_BAND.rationale: Early and late grace are one inclusive band around the appointment window.

WAREHOUSE_LIVE.rationale: Snapshot and detention are two publish surfaces of the same warehouse-isolation invariant.
